questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a sign of fatigue?
questions.correctAnswerText: Ability to focus
questions.explanation: Driving while tired is dangerous. Signs of fatigue include trouble focusing, repeated yawning or eye rubbing, daydreaming, and drifting out of your lane.

questions.question: Rust around wheel nuts may mean:
questions.correctAnswerText: The nuts are loose.
questions.explanation: Rust around wheel nuts usually means they are loose. Check the tightness of the nuts if you see rust in this area.

questions.question: A driver should always:
questions.correctAnswerText: Have an emergency plan.
questions.explanation: While driving, watch the road ahead to spot possible hazards early. Plan how you will handle hazards if they become dangerous.

questions.question: To operate a vehicle that transports hazardous materials, a driver must have:

options.text: A CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement.
A CDL with a passenger endorsement.
A CDL with an air brake endorsement.

questions.correctAnswerText: A CDL with a hazardous materials endorsement.
questions.explanation: You need a commercial driver license with a hazardous materials endorsement before driving any size vehicle used to transport hazardous materials. This is true even if the vehicle is not carrying hazardous materials at the time.

questions.question: In very hot weather, tires should be checked regularly because:

options.text: Air pressure may increase with the temperature.
The tread wears down extra quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Air pressure may increase with the temperature.
questions.explanation: Air expands when it gets hotter, so tire air pressure can reach dangerously high levels in very hot weather. If this happens, stop and let your tires cool. Do not let air out, as pressure will drop too low once the tires cool down.

questions.question: If a package shows "Inhalation Hazard," what placard must be used?
questions.correctAnswerText: Poison gas
questions.explanation: If "Inhalation Hazard" appears on a package or shipping papers, you must display the "Poison Inhalation Hazard" or "Poison Gas" placard.

questions.question: Outage:

options.text: Should not be considered when loading liquid cargo.
Is the same for each liquid.
Should be considered when determining how much liquid to load into a tank.
Is only a concern in warm weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be considered when determining how much liquid to load into a tank.
questions.explanation: Liquids expand when they get warmer. You must leave space in a tank for this expansion. This space is called "outage." Different liquids need different amounts of outage.

questions.question: Combination vehicles need more road space than other commercial vehicles because they are longer and they:

options.text: Need more space to turn and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Need more space to turn and stop.
questions.explanation: Combination vehicles need more road space than other commercial vehicles because they are longer and require more space to turn and stop. Proper space management is very important when driving combination vehicles.

questions.question: What does the trailer air supply control look like?

options.text: It is a square blue knob.
It is a triangular yellow knob.
It is an eight-sided red knob.
It is a circular orange knob.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is an eight-sided red knob.
questions.explanation: On newer vehicles, the trailer air supply control is an eight-sided red knob. It controls the tractor protection valve.

questions.question: If unsure if a trailer has ABS, you can:

options.text: Check under the trailer for wheel speed sensors coming from the back of the brakes.
Try driving on a slippery surface and see if ABS kicks in.
Remove a tire and look for the ABS sensor on the axle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check under the trailer for wheel speed sensors coming from the back of the brakes.
questions.explanation: Trailers built on or after March 1, 1998 must have Anti-Lock Braking Systems (ABS). A yellow warning light indicates ABS is present. For older trailers, check under the trailer for wheel speed sensor wires coming from the back of the brakes to see if ABS is installed.

questions.question: What is a good way to reduce stress while driving?
questions.correctAnswerText: Listen to calming music
questions.explanation: Stress while driving can lead to dangerous behavior. Calming music helps you relax and drive safely.

questions.question: Why are roads most slippery right after it starts to rain?

options.text: Water mixes with oil and grease on the road.
Gravel gets washed to the middle of the lane.
Some tires are not designed for rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: Water mixes with oil and grease on the road.
questions.explanation: When rain first starts, water mixes with oil that has dripped onto the road. This creates a slippery surface.

questions.question: How can you avoid making sudden lane changes?

options.text: Use your horn to make other drivers move.
Always drive slower than the speed limit.
Watch the road ahead while driving.
Pull off the road and wait in heavy traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch the road ahead while driving.
questions.explanation: Look ahead on the road to see obstacles coming. This gives you time to plan lane changes and avoid sudden moves.

questions.question: When does hydroplaning usually happen?

options.text: Where water builds up on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Where water builds up on the road.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens where water pools on the road. Low tire pressure and worn tires increase the risk. It can happen at speeds as low as 30 mph if there is enough water.

questions.question: What is a Class 7 hazardous material?
questions.correctAnswerText: Radioactive
questions.explanation: Class 7 hazardous materials are radioactive.

questions.question: Is it legal to carry liquids in a leaking tank?

options.text: Yes, if it is only for a short distance.
Yes, if you are running late.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it is illegal.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to transport any gas or liquid in a leaking tank. Always check tanks for leaks before driving.

questions.question: What is the average driver's reaction time?

options.text: Between three-quarters of a second and one second

questions.correctAnswerText: Between three-quarters of a second and one second
questions.explanation: The average driver takes between three-quarters of a second and one second to react to something.

questions.question: What happens if air pressure is lost in the emergency line?

options.text: The trailer detaches from the tractor.

questions.correctAnswerText: The emergency brakes activate.
questions.explanation: The emergency air line controls the emergency brakes. If air pressure is lost, the emergency brakes will activate.

questions.question: If a traffic light has been green for a long time, what should you expect?

options.text: It will probably stay green as you approach.
The light will soon turn yellow.
The light will go directly from green to red.

questions.correctAnswerText: The light will soon turn yellow.
questions.explanation: If a light has been green for a long time, it will likely turn yellow soon. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When driving, where should you look?

options.text: Only in front of your vehicle
Only in front and to the right
Only in front and to the sides
In front, to the sides, and behind your vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: In front, to the sides, and behind your vehicle
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires awareness of all directions. Check your mirrors often to see what is happening to the sides and rear of your vehicle.
